messages:
Gabe M: Quick planning thread for the Plume launch + webinar. Need final deliverables: keyword-to-post mapping, small schema package (Event + Speaker + FAQ), internal anchor map, redirect precedence table, and inbound routing (GTM -> HubSpot). Lock by EOD Tue.

Rina L: I'll own redirect precedence & canonical cluster. Plan: keep /plume as canonical, make a precedence table for redirects so we don't conflict with campaign-specific UTMs. Will upload CSV with `source,target,type,precedence`.

Zoey K: I'll do keywords & internal link plan across the four assets (launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar landing, evergreen guide). Aim to avoid exact-match anchor >2x.

Alvin (infra-bot): Reminder: redirect CSV header must be `source,target,type,notes`. Upload to `s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-cluster.csv`. Use `/deploy redirects plume-cluster`. I will post deploy status.

Olivia (seo-bot): SEO notes: 1) add Speaker Person markup to landing to increase speaker rich result chances; 2) include FAQ schema on landing plus one launch post variant (A/B); 3) avoid duplicate meta descriptions across launch and benchmarks. Also suggest `link rel=alternate` not to confuse canonical flows for localized variants.

Rina L: redirect precedence sample (small):
```
source,target,type,precedence
/plume-preview-2026,/plume,301,100
/plume-webinar-register,/plume,301,200 # keep lower precedence so campaign slugs can override if needed
```

Zoey K: keyword mapping summary: primary kw "low-latency inference" -> launch post; "inference benchmark results" -> benchmark narrative; "serving inference at scale" -> evergreen guide; webinar landing -> registration intent + long-tail queries. I'll upload anchor matrix to Drive: https://drive.google.com/PLUME-CLUSTER-ANCHORS

Gabe M: inbound routing: GTM params we agreed: `utm_source=product_marketing&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=plume_launch`. Add `&audience=enterprise` for paid lists. HubSpot webhook will map `audience` -> SFDC lane. Raj on ops will verify the webhook mapping (cc @Raj but not in thread).

Olivia (seo-bot): Structured data draft for speaker (tiny):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Person","name":"Dr. Priya S","jobTitle":"Head of Inference","affiliation":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
(put inside script type="application/ld+json" on landing)

Rina L: acceptance criteria checklist: redirects uploaded + smoke-tested (curl -I to verify header), canonical tags verified on all variants, schema present on landing + one launch post variant, internal anchors live in copy, sitemap updated, and GTM -> HubSpot mapping validated.

Zoey K: I'll also run a quick canonical cluster audit to ensure no index bloat. Will flag any thin pages.

Alvin (infra-bot): After upload run `/deploy redirects plume-cluster` here. I will return success/fail with job id. Also note: if precedence collision detected, deploy will fail and list conflicts.

Gabe M: please drop 1-line status in the tracker when you finish your piece. If any blocker, escalate to eng-infra and tag @deploy-oncall. Thanks! :rocket:
